profile.name: Newport ESP301 多轴电机运动控制器
profile.description: 用于驱动和协调多轴电动位移台、线性/旋转平台及执行器的实验室运动控制器。它支持回零、位置与速度控制、限位管理以及伺服参数整定，常用于光学对准、样品定位、自动扫描和精密运动实验。
profile.description_en: A laboratory multi-axis motion controller used to drive and coordinate motorized stages, linear or rotary stages, and actuators. It supports homing, position and velocity control, limit handling, and servo tuning, and is commonly used for optical alignment, sample positioning, automated scanning, and precision motion experiments.
